p.i: ADmonebo Lectorem me-um de duobus : De uno quidem, quod in limine Epistolæ ad Reverendum virum Petrum Mussardum, affirmo post Salmasium, Episcopatum fuisse pestem, & radicem omnium malorum, tum invexisse Papam in orbem Christianum ; unde Judicium vieum crimini dabitur in Ecclesiam Anglicanam, quæ Episcopatum retinuit, à quo

page.notes: The first word of the paragraph is a large woodcut initial "A" joined to "Admonebo"; the first line reads "ADmonebo" with the initial as printed. Line "Judicium vieum" is printed as shown (likely "vicem" or "vitium"; uncertain, marked by the printing). The final word "quo" is printed at the right of the last line and continues beyond the page. The asterisk is a printed reference mark placed under the text. The text is set in italic type with roman headings; the word "Mussardum" and "Salmasium" are as printed. The woodcut border ornaments are not transcribed.
